mapper.insert: INSERT INTO person_employment (workspace_id, person_id, company_id, company_name, title, started_at, ended_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{personId}, #{companyId}, #{companyName}, #{title}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, person_id, company_id, company_name, title, started_at, ended_at, created_at FROM person_employment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY (ended_at IS NULL) DESC, started_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT cur.person_id AS person_id, p.name AS person_name, p.image_url AS person_image_url, prev.company_id AS from_company_id, prev.company_name AS from_company_name, cur.company_id AS to_company_id, cur.company_name AS to_company_name, cur.started_at AS moved_at FROM person_employment cur JOIN person p ON p.id = cur.person_id AND p.archived_at IS NULL JOIN person_employment prev ON prev.person_id = cur.person_id AND prev.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND prev.ended_at = ( SELECT MAX(pe.ended_at) FROM person_employment pe WHERE pe.person_id = cur.person_id AND pe.ended_at IS NOT NULL ) WHERE cur.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND cur.ended_at IS NULL AND cur.started_at IS NOT NULL AND cur.started_at >= #{since} ORDER BY cur.started_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
